most_likely_explanation: A genuine ~1000 ppm, 15.313-d, ~4-h flat-bottomed transit-like dip on the G=16.5 K/G dwarf Gaia DR3 2100154070473374976 itself (or on something unresolved within ~1-2 arcsec of it). It is not on the TPF host KIC 3831977 (host folds flat to +/-22 ppm), not on any Gaia source within 25 arcsec (each rejected by delta-chi2 > 65 per season in a free-centre difference-image fit that places the deficit 0.3-0.4 arcsec from the target in three independent seasons/pixel orientations), not a single-channel artefact (present in all four seasons/channels 12, 16, 76, 72), and not a known KOI/TCE/EB/confirmed planet or a Bienias & Szabo 2025 candidate. Implied companion radius ~3-4 Earth radii. The remaining failure mode is the generic unresolved-blend space (faint EB or hierarchical triple inside the PSF), which only TRICERATOPS plus high-resolution imaging can address.
surviving_strengths: Host KIC 3831977 (G=15.0, 7.9 arcsec away) shows no dip at the ephemeris: PSF -44 +/- 22 ppm, SAP +20 +/- 21 ppm, all seasons consistent with zero; host origin excluded directly and by absence of any DR25 TCE on the host.

Free-centre Gaussian fit to season-stacked per-event difference images (my own code on the cached TPFs) puts the deficit 0.33, 0.32 and 0.40 arcsec from the target (formal +/-0.4 arcsec) in seasons 0, 1, 3, with chi2 at target within 1-2 of the free fit; every Gaia neighbour within 25 arcsec (G 15.0-20.5) is rejected by delta-chi2 > 65 in each season. Because the pixel grid rotates 90 deg between seasons, any off-stamp contaminant would have to be unresolved (<~2 arcsec).

Integrated missing light in the stamp (2.6-2.9 +/- 0.6 e/s) equals what a ~1000 ppm dip on a 3217 e/s star with psffrac 0.83 produces (2.2-3.2 e/s): no room for a much brighter hidden eclipsing source.

Signal present in all four Kepler seasons on four different channels (12, 16, 76, 72), with 86 events, 91% individually positive, single-event dominance 0.076, 10% of events within 1 d of a gap; 15.31 d is not a Kepler cadence or harmonic. Inverted-flux null SDE 9.5 vs 52.6 real.

No KOI, DR25 TCE, Kirk+2016 EB, confirmed planet or TESS EB within 3 arcmin; no object anywhere in the field matches both period (any harmonic 1/3-3) and epoch; the closest period twin K00475.02 (P=15.31296 d, 570 arcmin away) is 3.1 d off in phase.

Gaia RUWE 1.057.
Independent re-derivation (different code) recovers P, depth, duration, odd/even, secondary and event count within 1 sigma; pipeline and re-derivation per-event depths correlate at 0.97.

SAP/PSF depth ratio 0.69 +/- 0.06 matches the on-target expectation from measured flux levels (FLFRCSAP x F_psf/F_sap = 0.71; 0.79 with FLFRCSAP=1), 0.4-1.8 sigma; per season all within 1.3 sigma. A dip on a resolved neighbour would require a ratio > 0.79. The earlier 'tension' came from header CROWDSAP (0.87-0.94) understating the host's contamination of the SAP aperture; the catalogue value 0.763 is the per-quarter minimum.
TOI/CTOI (ExoFOP, downloaded 2026-10-17): target TIC 120425498 (Tmag 16.0), host TIC 120425499 and the four faint neighbour TICs are not TOIs/CTOIs; none within 3 arcmin.
checks_run: Read vet.json, events.csv, fold_events.png, pixel.json (per-quarter table), diffimages.png and the independent re-derivation results/comparison.
Downloaded KBONUS light curve of the TPF host KIC 3831977 and folded PSF and SAP flux at the ephemeris, globally, per season and per quarter (flat).

# Red-team review: kic-003831969 — verdict: SURVIVES (with caveats)

Full notes: `/home/user/ZyushgPlanet/runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-003831969/redteam.md`; my code and outputs: `/home/user/ZyushgPlanet/runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-003831969/redteam_work/` (`lc_tests.py/json`, `pix_free_sigfix.py/json/png`, `season2_map.py`, `shape_test.py`). Candidate language only; this is a stage-2 signal with pixel localisation, not a planet.

## What I tried to kill it with, and what happened

**Host star.** KBONUS PSF/SAP flux of the TPF host KIC 3831977 (G=15.0, 7.9" E) folded at P=15.31335 d, t0=BKJD 144.28486: -44 +/- 22 ppm and +20 +/- 21 ppm, flat in every season. Host origin excluded.

**Catalogued neighbours / blended EB.** Own free-centre Gaussian fit to season-stacked per-event difference images on the cached TPFs: deficit centre 0.33", 0.32", 0.40" from the target (formal +/-0.4") in seasons 0, 1, 3; chi2 at target within 1-2 of the free fit; every Gaia source within 25" (G 15.0-20.5) rejected by delta-chi2 > 65 per season. Pixel grid rotates between seasons, so any off-stamp contaminant would have to be unresolved. Season 2 (target in the corner pixel of a 4x5 stamp) is geometrically degenerate and its residual chi2 is a jitter dipole on the host's pixels, not a deficit elsewhere. Integrated missing light 2.6-2.9 e/s matches 3217 e/s x depth x psffrac (2.2-3.2 e/s): no brighter hidden source.

**Systematics.** Present on four channels (12, 16, 76, 72); 86 events, 91% positive, single-event dominance 0.076, 10% within 1 d of a gap; period is no Kepler cadence/harmonic; inverted null SDE 9.5 vs 52.6.

**Ephemeris contamination.** Nothing within 3' in KOI/TCE/EB/confirmed/TESS-EB; no object in the field matches period (any harmonic 1/3-3) *and* epoch; the closest twin K00475.02 (15.31296 d, 570' away) is 3.1 d off in phase. Crosstalk would also need a Kp<11 deep EB with this ephemeris; none exists.

**Already known?** Not in KOI/TCE/EB/confirmed lists; not among Bienias & Szabo 2025's seven candidates (Appendix B from Zenodo checked); no published KBONUS-team candidate list; SIMBAD has only a UCAC4 entry.

**Shape/secondary/duration.** Cadence-smeared trapezoid: depth 1030 ppm, T14 4.06 h, T23/T14 = 0.80 (V-shape disfavoured by delta-chi2 >= 8). Secondary -4 +/- 48 ppm (3-sigma < 14% of primary); odd/even 0.3-0.5 sigma. T14 matches a central transit of the 0.83 Rsun catalogue host (4.08 h) or moderate b on an extinction-corrected ~1.0-1.1 Rsun host; implied radius 2.7-4.0 Re.

## Caveats recorded (not kills)
- PSF depth per season 1199/1089/836/772 ppm (+/-100-135): chi2 9.3/3 with white errors, 4.1/3 after the measured x1.5 red-noise inflation. Shallower in the two seasons with lowest psffrac.
- SAP/PSF depth ratio 0.69 +/- 0.06 vs CROWDSAP 0.87-0.94 (2-3 sigma low): PSF depth may be ~20% over-estimated at the stamp edge. Quote depth/radius with ~25% systematics.
- Pipeline empirical SNR 23.8 is optimistic; the random-phase value is 19.6.

## What would settle it
TRICERATOPS with the Gaia field + secondary/odd-even constraints; AO/speckle imaging; a PRF-model (not Gaussian) difference-image fit; a stamp-truncation-aware PSF refit to resolve the season/SAP tensions; extinction-corrected host radius.

Sources consulted online: [Bienias & Szabo 2025 (arXiv:2501.09152)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09152), [Zenodo Appendix B](https://zenodo.org/records/14618752), [KBONUS-BKG HLSP page](https://archive.stsci.edu/hlsp/kbonus-bkg), [Martinez-Palomera et al. 2023](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2310.17733), [EXBA 2021 paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2112.06683), [Moquin et al. 2026 poster](https://vmnexsci.ipac.caltech.edu/workshop/2026/posters/Poster_JulieMoquin_41.pdf).
